svg.title: A peak is not yet a path: generated ChirpMotion controls
svg.desc: All 961 raw signed PCM16 samples and all 513 unnormalized spectrum bins per generated case. One component is usable at 298.828125 Hz. Competing components are ambiguous with null delay and path. The declared start is supplied; this is heuristic screening, not physical calibration.
